dialogues.text: Welcome, friend, to the Ayar Heroes' Cup. I'm the organizer.

dialogues.text: Today's the last day of the competition. If you want to claim the crown, you'll need to defeat our top three warriors back to back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is the Ayar Heroes' Cup?

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: It's a battle for the glory of Ayar! Use fists, weapons, or any other trick in the book to defeat your opponent!

dialogues.text: And is Ayar a... person, or...?

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: My friend, only champions are qualified to ask questions here!

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: Get on stage! We'll soon see if you have the strength to earn that respect.
